pages.title: Fire, Tailored
pages.text: Turn earned Ignitium into a particular armor piece’s useful function.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Supply your own template and ingot. Helmet uses Blazing Brand gaze; chestplate supports Flame Reflex and Elytra combination, and the set has its own Lava Walker behavior. Choose one active feature. Monstrous Helm separately activates below half health; deliberately risking death is not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Ignitium uses its own smithing upgrade; helmet, chestplate and boots differ. Monstrous Helm has a separate health threshold.
